tooltip: Returns the current biome's water, grass, or foliage tint at this Block Overlay element's target block (using its x/y/z automatically) as a hex color string (e.g. #5f9c46), smoothed the same way vanilla blends biome colors across nearby chunks. Plug this straight into a Block Overlay's color input. Only usable inside a Block Overlay element, where x/y/z are defined.
